summary: The edition has 96 complete guides and 21 screened discoveries. It completes 35 earlier pending guides and details 6 substantive release updates. LiveAudio documents an OBS caption overlay on Windows and Linux. CalibRaw marks subjects with device-side models for reversible RAW adjustments. The archival guides show how to correct machine-written drafts and export page layout. Music and fabrication guides describe how to keep generated work editable. SDAI documents separate iOS and Android diffusion runtimes. Open Body Tracker adds an INT8 CPU mode. OpenStitch and ZigZag update agent-assisted stitch workflows, and ComfyUI adds a deflicker route and removes DirectML. Code grants were read in full. Models, services, creative inputs and hardware or software hosts have separate requirements. This edition is based on source review and published documentation. No discovered app was installed or run. The expanded plan covered 117 fields, 1342/1342 repository-query attempts and 35 model tasks. The repository lane recorded 1342 successful, 0 partial and 0 failed queries, with 253 bounded. The model lane recorded 0 failed tasks. Metadata from 2,821 saved repository pages included 84,187 numeric identities. The complete retained backlog spans 118,555 candidates, including pilot history and 1,094 previously screened guides still pending before this edition. Creative relevance and the complete software grant were checked before including any discovery. Unreviewed and excluded records stay in local research. Live primary research yielded 578 complete usable responses from 686 distinct URL attempts, including a non-GitHub source in each of 117 fields. 14 captures reached the size bound. The ecosystem checks cover all 8 configured groups and record available findings and gaps. Evidence labels in this edition are 0 Recommended, 0 Ready to try, 107 Quality unverified, 10 Experimental. Updated evidence labels for previous entries: IgniteFuse (Quality unverified to Experimental), InvokeAI (Quality unverified to Experimental). 33 model tasks reached the configured response limit of 50 rows. A model record remains a discovery lead until code and use are verified. Model tasks with no rows: text2text-generation, zero-shot-audio-classification. The separate watchlist made 64 unsuccessful repository checks. Collection logged 4 enrichment failures. Credential-shaped material in unsealed captures was removed before sealing. The affected source origins and before-and-after hashes remain in private evidence.
